evals.prompt: 制作一份16:9项目推进甘特图PPT。用户坚持尽量一页展示12条研发任务、8个时间节点、牵头方和逐项成果，文字必须能在完整页面视图中直接看清。请创建最终PPTX并完成结构、字号和视觉验收；当一页与可读性冲突时自行处理，不要把取舍留到交付后。
evals.expected_output: 生成经过验收的PPTX；若一页无法满足可读性则精简或拆页，普通文字不低于18 pt，且不使用未授权字号例外。
expectations: A PowerPoint output exists and passes OOXML structure validation.
The typography audit reports zero failures and no user-authorized exception manifest is used.
All 12 tasks and all 8 milestones remain represented after any simplification or slide split.
A full-slide render is produced and no essential text requires cropping or zooming to read.

evals.prompt: 制作一页技术汇报PPT，内容包括一个36字左右的结论、一张带横纵坐标与图例的原生柱状图、三条分析说明，并在页脚放两条来源链接。请交付PPTX和验收证据。
evals.expected_output: 普通文字、图表坐标和图例不低于18 pt；来源链接不低于10 pt；文件结构、字号与完整页面视觉检查均通过。
expectations: The output uses a native editable chart rather than a rasterized replacement.
Ordinary text, chart axes, and the legend are at least 18 pt effective size.
Both genuine source links are at least 10 pt and are classified as source text.
Structure validation, typography audit, and full-slide visual inspection all pass.

evals.prompt: 在输出目录先创建一份三页模拟旧PPT：第一页标题24 pt、正文12 pt，第二页表格文字11 pt，第三页图表坐标10 pt。然后按用户要求只修改第一页标题文字并交付新版。不要询问是否顺便处理其他页，按你的PPT技能完成整个编辑和验收流程。
evals.expected_output: 不仅完成标题修改，还把整份输出中的普通小字重新排版到至少18 pt；最终PPTX整稿通过字号、结构和视觉验收。
expectations: The requested first-slide title edit is present in the final deck.
All three output slides, including previously untouched table and chart text, pass the 18 pt ordinary-text gate.
No blanket or stale exception is used to preserve legacy small text.
The final deck passes structure validation, typography audit, and full-slide visual inspection.
